claude_result_text:
I have significantly improved the `window_door_lines` by:
1.  Updating the main-deck window loop to have a more realistic count (45 windows per side) and a better spatial distribution along the fuselage, starting after the cockpit area and ending before the tail cone. I also increased their depth slightly for better visibility from different angles.
2.  Refining the upper-deck Windows on the hump: they now cover a larger portion of the forward upper deck (spanning approximately -3 to 15) with a consistent spacing, ensuring they are clearly separated and distinct as per the judging requirements.

These changes directly address the "clean main-deck window line," "separate upper-deck windows on the hump," and improved cockpit/cabin layout targets identified in the feedback.
